clauses.reason: Section 1(a) establishes the Committee on Foreign Investment in the United States, composed of designated representatives and chaired by the Treasury representative, who may invite other agencies to participate. Executive Order 13456 section 3(a) re-establishes the Committee 'as provided in the Act' (section 721 of the Defense Production Act of 1950), and section 4(c) and (d) retain a chairperson; Executive Orders 12860 (1993), 13286 (2003) and 13456 (2008) changed the membership. Executive Order 12661 (1988) added sections 7 and 8 and Executive Order 13603 (2012) sections 802 and 803(b) refer to the order as amended without changing it. The establishment continues as restated; the Committee exists on 2026-10-14.

Executive Order 13456 section 1 later replaced the text without this section, a formal removal after the earlier cessation.

research_rationale:
Executive Order 11858 of May 7, 1975 (40 FR 20263; held text jobs/fr-originals/data/full_run/texts/EO_11858.txt, read in full) established the Committee on Foreign Investment in the United States (section 1), assigned data duties to the Secretary of Commerce (section 2), authorized one year of Exchange Stabilization Fund use (section 3), directed agency assistance (section 4), protected confidential information (section 5) and saved other authorities (section 6). Executive Orders 12188 (1980), 12661 (1988, adding sections 7 and 8 on investigations and presidential action), 12860 (1993) and 13286 (2003) amended it, and Executive Order 13456 (January 23, 2008, read in full) amended the order to read as a full restatement. Under the strike-and-insert ruling the clauses that the restatement carries forward continue as amended and the clauses it does not carry forward ended when it took effect. Section 3 ended earlier by its own one-year term. Executive Order 13603 (March 16, 2012) section 803(b) confirms the order as amended remains in effect. The listed Office of the Federal Register amendments were all checked; Executive Order 12977 appears in the dossier chain for this order but its held text does not mention Executive Order 11858 (the cited provision is the Executive Order 13286 amendment), so it is not treated as an amendment. The order is operative on 2026-10-14 as amended.
